source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(out), len(out[0])
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if out[r][0] != 0 and all(v == out[r][0] for v in out[r])]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if out[0][c] != 0 and all(out[r][c] == out[0][c] for r in range(h))]
    for r in rows:
        out[r] = [2 if v != 0 else v for v in out[r]]
    for c in cols:
        for r in range(h):
            if out[r][c] != 0:
                out[r][c] = 2
    return out
'''
p.write_text(source)
mod=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task',p); m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(mod); mod.loader.exec_module(m)
actual=m.transform(parse(inp))
print('demo_matches',actual==parse(out_demo))
print('test output')
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in m.transform(grid)))
